I've been an Xbox gamer since 2009, and I loved the Xbox 360's controller. My only complaints were:

  • D-pad should've had hard-set travel directions rather than floating directions
  • Heat (and, as a result, sweat) had no way of escaping
  • Stick grips wore down quickly

When I saw the Xbox One's reveal, I was excited to try the controller because its new design and impulse triggers, and bought into Microsoft's idea of "we took everything you loved about the 360's controller, and made it better."

After playing with the Xbox One's controller on a daily basis for the past month, I...really dislike the controller. The impulse triggers and the visual design are awesome, but it just flat out feels uncomfortable to hold. My hands hurt after using it. I tried out a number of different ways of holding it – all of which either ended up with me losing performance or hurting even more.

Are there any more ergonomic alternatives for the Xbox One controller anyone could recommend? I really, really like the Dualshock 4 controller, but I doubt there's any reliable way of using it with my Xbox.

Unfortunately, there is no way to use the DS4 with the Xbox One. As for complaints about being uncomfortable, I actually haven't heard that a lot. Maybe you should look into the Xbox One Elite controller? It's geared more toward "pro" gamers, but it looks more comfortable and you can change the way you hold it with the alternate buttons on the back
